purpose_context: Building the controller-first UI by hand-painting every rect in egui has cost far more effort than the design warrants; a one-day spike (spike/webview-mixer, Op 01KZ9CN8E0YEMQEZQG8Q7VEESM) rendered the full authored MIXER screen from the production SemanticGraphicalViewModel JSON in 244 lines of HTML/CSS, replacing the density-policy arithmetic with one CSS grid rule. This mission makes that real: a Tauri v2 window whose webview renders the MIXER context at authored-design parity — projection, focus, adjustment, meters — while physical input capture, the reducer, and the real-time audio boundaries stay exactly where DESIGN.md puts them. The webview is a projection surface only; the egui shell remains the running default behind a flag. PATCH, modals, and egui retirement follow in a successor mission.
purpose_tldr: Replace the hand-painted egui rendering of the MIXER screen with a Tauri webview projection surface fed by the existing semantic view model, behind a flag, with egui still the default.
